description: PAID $0.002 USDC. Best USDC yield on Base (or any chain/token): top 10 pools ranked by risk-adjusted APY with APY, TVL and 0-100 risk score. Example: chain=Base, token=USDC. Takes chain, token or both. Refreshed about every 30 min. Returns JSON for the top 10 matching pools: APY, TVL, and a 0-100 risk score, ranked by risk-adjusted APY.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Optional chain name. Format: a chain name. Example: Base. The tool text also names Ethereum and Arbitrum. Omit to search every chain.

token.description: Optional token symbol. Format: an uppercase symbol. Example: USDC. The tool text also names ETH. Omit to search every token.
